preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 4 * 10**5 for n, k, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices n is between 1 and 4 * 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 2 * 10**5 for n, k, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of operations k is between 1 and 2 * 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, k, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges) for n, k, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, k, edges in test_cases) <= 4 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of the number of vertices across all test cases does not exceed 4 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= n for (n, k, edges), result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of remaining vertices after k operations is between 0 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == 0 if k >= n - 1 else result > 0 for (n, k, edges), result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if k is greater than or equal to n - 1, the result is 0; otherwise, the result is greater than 0.
